name: Topic library grid
purpose: Let visitors browse the content library by topic through a grid of linked topic cards under a centred heading.
description: Legacy content (yellow) theme: a centred serif 4rem H2 header in a side-hairline frame over a 3-col grid (1 col <=767) of hairline link cards, each with a 20px/500 title, grey copy and a 3:2 topic image; hover reveals a dotted radial-gradient texture instantly. The component also has a 'suites' variant (split header + button + 6 sector cards) but no real page uses it; only 'topics' (/content/topics) is live and modelled.

evidenceNotes: Card copy on /content/topics comes from prose(n, seed) in src/pages/content/filler.js (evaluated with node); texts start mid-sentence by design. The component's own words(n) defaults (max 51 words) are not shown on any route; the page's longest is 61 words (Safety at work).
The 'suites' variant is NOT used by any page (only src/pages/__preview-e renders it). /content/sector-suites renders GridSplitLegacy variant='suites' instead.
CLONE_SPEC_PAGES.md section A / line 615 say topics-grid covers both catalogue routes via a variant; code and pages-manifest.json sectionsByRoute put grid-split-legacy on /content/sector-suites.
The H2 header is the second heading on the page (HeaderGridCard carries the H1), so this index block does not carry the H1.
